role: The source of a command execution: name, chat component, chat output, permission check, position and world.
scope_reason: Commands never run in this game: the product has no chat text entry (no chat handling in csrc/play/play.c) and no harness path constructs ServerCommandManager (grep of oracle/harness finds none); the behaviors the project needs are the Dev ops of oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Dev.java and csrc/engine/dev.c, not this command system.
notes: Implemented by EntityPlayerMP, CommandBlockLogic and the dedicated-server console sources; the native dev ops address the session player directly and never go through this interface. Static __OBFID constants are grouped out per the brief.
